name: @recto/vim-js
description: codemirror-vim's keymap core, bundled DOM-free for JavaScriptCore behind a Swift adapter

scripts.build: bun scripts/extract-core.ts && bun build src/index.js --outfile dist/recto-vim.js --format=iife --target=browser --minify
scripts.build:dev: bun scripts/extract-core.ts && bun build src/index.js --outfile dist/recto-vim.dev.js --format=iife --target=browser
